name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, sparked by the roar of engines during the Singapore Grand Prix. This early passion led her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, where she specialized in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduation, she joined a local engineering firm, contributing to various automotive projects before landing a role at a junior formula team as a data analyst. 

Her meticulous nature and innovative problem-solving skills quickly propelled her through the ranks. She transitioned to a race engineer role, honing her skills at trackside and mastering the art of translating data into performance gains. Mei Lian believes in fostering a collaborative environment, empowering her team to push boundaries and explore unconventional solutions. Her calm demeanor under pressure and knack for strategic decision-making make her an invaluable asset to any team, particularly in the high-stakes world of motorsport. 

Now as Technical Director for Hot Racing Team, Mei Lian brings a unique blend of technical expertise and leadership skills, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair pulled back into a neat ponytail with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Mei Lian has a focused gaze and a determined expression, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a quick recap of the previous race's technical highlights and areas for improvement.
